research_question: Does a causal liquidity-sweep -> displacement FVG -> body-close inversion -> first confirmed retest sequence create positive frozen 30-second XAUUSD persistence on M1 or M5?

reconstructible_rules: sweep = wick through confirmed swing and close back inside
swing must be extreme of preceding 50 bars
FVG displacement must agree with sweep-implied reaction
inversion requires body close through candidate gap rather than wick probe

source_basis.source: MQL5 The Inverse Fair Value Gap Trading Strategy / MQL5 IFVG implementation articles
source_basis.role: independent IFVG polarity-flip and retest support
reconstructible_rules: re-entry/retest after inversion is a distinct state
low execution timeframes are appropriate for IFVG logic

causal_semantics.swing_shape: one bar left + center + one bar right; becomes visible after right bar closes
causal_semantics.sweep: price wicks beyond latest eligible confirmed extreme and closes back inside on same completed bar
causal_semantics.fvg: wick-to-wick 3-bar imbalance formed in sweep-implied reaction direction
causal_semantics.inversion: first later completed candle close cleanly through far edge of candidate FVG
causal_semantics.retest: first later completed bar overlaps inverted zone and closes back on inversion side with matching directional body
causal_semantics.entry: first P75 executable tick at/after retest-bar right edge
causal_semantics.calendar_gap_rule: FVG construction requires consecutive chart bars; prevents weekend/session discontinuity artifact

fixed_cleanroom_approximations.rationale: Primary source exposes both as configurable windows but public prose does not disclose exact current defaults; fixed to the same disclosed 50-bar lifecycle horizon before compute. No result-dependent tuning allowed.

gate.advance_if: at least one fixed lane satisfies all three gates
gate.no_rescue_rule: No threshold/session/exit tuning if both fixed lanes fail.
